name: BLN600 (British Library 19th-century newspapers)
description: 600 newspaper article images with human transcriptions.
use_reason: Non-commercial, no-derivatives: may never ship (O4). Approved for evaluation only (owner, O4 amendment, 23 Nov 2026): never trained on, never redistributed, nothing committed except IDs and numbers, results reported separately from O4-clear data, dropped if IRIS becomes commercial.
download_status_here: not downloaded here: host not reachable from the sandbox (orda.shef.ac.uk (figshare))

pack.page_addressing: page ID = GALE document ID; members Images/<id>.jpg|.tif and 'Ground Truth'/<id>.txt

estimate.how: range reads: 75 article images (size per image unknown, ~2 MB assumed for mixed JPG/TIFF) + transcriptions; archive name and size resolved from the figshare API on first run

notes: Unmodified redistribution only (ND): converted ground truth stays on the owner's machine and in the dev export only.

The publishers protect the archive with a password given on the dataset page, so that users read the licence first. It is not stored in this repository: whoever runs fetch_pack reads the licence on the dataset page and supplies the password at run time (--archive-password bln600=<password> or the IRIS_BLN600_PASSWORD environment variable). Without it, BLN600 is skipped.
Python can open ZipCrypto but not AES archives: the run stops and says so if the archive uses AES.
